title: OpenQuest
reason: OpenQuest has strong first-party reuse and redistribution evidence, a creator-controlled CC-BY-4.0 repository/release, a pinned v1.0 source identity, and an exact creator-release binary match to ScummVM's Wintermute detector. Production still remains HOLD because the pinned v1.0 license record identifies a bundled third-party Verb Bar with no formal redistribution license. A surviving author discussion offers MIT relicensing if needed, but Abandonware does not treat an offer as an executed grant.
